items.content:
Everyone treats horror as the disreputable genre and I have stopped
arguing politely about it.

It is the only genre whose entire job is to look directly at the thing
people organise their lives around not looking at. Death, the body,
what's under the floor, what a family does to each other. Drama gestures
at it. Horror puts it on screen and makes you watch.

That it also contains a lot of garbage is true of every genre and nobody
holds it against comedy.

summary: Horror as the only genre that stares at what we avoid
title: Horror does the looking
